methods.label: Rationalize with the conjugate
methods.explanation: Multiply the numerator and denominator by \(\sqrt{5}-\sqrt{3}\): \(\frac{\sqrt{5}-\sqrt{3}}{5-3}=\frac{1}{2}(\sqrt{5}-\sqrt{3})\), so \(k=\frac{1}{2}\).
